# healthcare-imaging

Medical imaging toolkit for PACS, RIS, VNA, modalities, gateways and viewers: DICOM, DICOMweb, PS3.15 security and IHE Radiology, targeted at your declared DICOM edition.

Install: `copilot plugin install healthcare-imaging@healthcare-copilot` (see the repository README).

## Agents
- `dicom-imaging-engineer`
- `ihe-profile-advisor`
- `healthcare-interop-architect`
